runsheet.short_description: Disconnect webinar audio+video from the auditorium.
[[Webinar Sentinel On-Site]] confirm where [[Zoom Master]] will sit.
Promote the organizing committee, [[Q&A Tracker]], [[Webinar Sentinel On-Site]], and maybe backstage to cohost in the Zoom webinar.

runsheet.more_info: Chat > menu > attendees can chat with: nobody.

runsheet.short_description: Grab a mic and keep it for the whole session.
Connect webinar audio+video to the auditorium.

Sit in the corner of the stage. Join Zoom on the provided laptop and disconnect audio+video. Keep both the Q&A panel and the participants view (for raised hands) open at all times. Balance online VS on-site questions.

Sit on-site in the backstage but view only the Zoom Webinar on the provided laptop. Not only listen, but try to understand the presentations --- you catch more issues this way. Keep the on-site screen visible so any mismatch is catched, but pay main attention to the webinar. Use the provided headphones. Upon issues, use judgement: Either unmute to raise the issue, or contact the [[Zoom Master]] immediately by walking to them.
If a panelist account is making noises, mute it.
Sit in the corner of the audience.
Whenever a question from the on-site audience is taken, give your mic to them.
Monitor the Webinar and report issues immediately to [#vol-alerts](https://ismir2026.slack.com/archives/C0CDNPPNJ0Z).
